items.name: use-announce
items.title: useAnnounce
items.description: Creates provider-free polite and assertive ARIA live regions and returns announce, announcePolite, announceAssertive, and clear functions for screen-reader updates. Use it for dynamic status messages, with defaultPoliteness and debounceMs options to control announcement urgency and rapid updates.

items.name: use-camera
items.title: useCamera
items.description: Controls browser camera previews, photo capture, video recording, device switching, zoom, focus, flash, timers, and optional keyboard, gesture, and voice input. It returns videoRef and gestureContainerRef plus stream, permission, device, and capture state and actions, with options for facingMode, media constraints, autoStart, capture format and quality, and lifecycle callbacks.

items.name: use-color-picker
items.title: useColorPicker
items.description: Manages controlled or uncontrolled HSVA color and alpha state and returns setters, recent colors, generated harmonies, contrast ratios, formatting, and clipboard-copy helpers. Use it to build color-picker interfaces with value/defaultValue, onValueChange, showAlpha, maxRecentColors, disabled, and readOnly options.

items.name: use-menu-action
items.title: useMenuAction
items.description: Runs dropdown or menubar actions as single-flight, abortable operations, passing an AbortSignal to each item's onSelect callback. Given a sessionKey and optional success/error callbacks, it returns run and reset plus state, activeId, message, and animatePending for rendering pending, success, and error feedback without stale sessions overwriting newer state.

items.name: use-optimistic-commit
items.title: useOptimisticCommit
items.description: Manages optimistic async value commits with automatic rollback, optional single-flight locking, and configurable error feedback via a local callback or OptimisticFeedbackProvider context adapter without coupling primitives to a toast module.

items.name: use-pagination
items.title: usePagination
items.description: Manages controlled or uncontrolled 1-indexed page, pageSize, and total state and returns page bounds, navigation flags and actions, ellipsis-aware getPageRange output, and getPageData for slicing local arrays. Use it for pagination controls that need configurable page ranges, atomic page-and-size updates, and optional bounds correction.

items.name: use-platform
items.title: usePlatform
items.description: Detects and caches the browser operating system from the user agent, returning "mac", "windows", "linux", or "unknown" without requiring options. Use it for platform-specific UI such as keyboard-shortcut labels; server rendering returns "unknown" before the client snapshot is applied.

items.name: use-press-bounce
items.title: usePressBounce
items.description: Accepts an element ref and enabled flag and returns a callback that runs an interruptible GSAP press animation scaling the element to 0.95 for 75ms before rebounding. Use it from press handlers for subtle button feedback; it does nothing when disabled or when reduced motion is preferred.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: Returns a live boolean for the user's prefers-reduced-motion: reduce media query and updates when the operating-system setting changes. Use it to gate JavaScript-driven animation, smooth scrolling, and timers; it returns false during SSR and hydration, with prefersReducedMotion also available for non-React reads.

items.name: use-visibility-pause
items.title: useVisibilityPause
items.description: Provides useDocumentVisible and useVisibilityPause hooks to pause looped animations and timers automatically when the document tab is hidden or the target element is scrolled offscreen.
